A '''senior administrator''' was a position held by certain individuals within the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].

==History==
[[Horell|One individual]] who held this title was hunting on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], accompanied by several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. While on his trip, a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] destroyed all his droids and confronted him, demanding he cease killing the natives. Wanting to be left alone, he attempted to bribe the bounty hunter. The administrator was unable to buy his way out of the predicament and was shot by the bounty hunter.<ref name="Bounty Hunter Gameplay">{{SWArchive|url=video/view/001045.html|text=''The Old Republic'': Bounty Hunter Gameplay|nobackup=1}}</ref>
